claim.definition: (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) from Sentinel-2 Collection 1 Level-2A surface reflectance, B4 averaged to 20 m; the median over clear core pixels within 300 m of the site; a scene counts when at least 80% of those pixels are clear (scene classification 2, 4, 5, 6 or 7).
claim.public_wording: A satellite reading of how green the water looked from space on the date shown: an index that rises with chlorophyll and floating or suspended plant material. It is not a test for harmful algae or toxins, and it is not swimming advice.

lab_definition.method_note: EA determinand 7887, 'Chlorophyll : Acetone Extract'. Not confirmed as chlorophyll-a; the phaeopigment correction is not stated (docs/LAKE-CHLOROPHYLL-NDCI-TEST-2026-10.md).
lab_definition.censoring: censored '<' means the lab reported below the limit given in value; '>' above it
lab_definition.source: Environment Agency Water Quality Archive, Open Government Licence v3.0
